scripts.deploy: git pull origin main && docker compose -f compose.prod.yaml down && pnpm install && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2560" pnpm run build --concurrency=1 && docker compose -f compose.prod.yaml up -d && pnpm --filter @repo/database exec prisma migrate deploy && pm2 restart retold
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.git:finish: branch=$(git branch --show-current) && git push origin $branch && git checkout main && git branch -D $branch
scripts.git:finish:win: powershell -Command "$branch = git branch --show-current; git push origin $branch; git checkout main; git branch -D $branch"
